activities.title: Breakfast at local cafe
activities.description: Enjoy a traditional Goan breakfast of poee and local tea near the coast.

activities.title: Relax at Baga Beach
activities.description: Stroll along the sandy shore and unwind under a beach umbrella at a relaxed pace.

activities.title: Seafood lunch
activities.description: Savor authentic Goan fish curry and rice at a beachside shack.

activities.title: Sunset view at Anjuna Beach
activities.description: Watch the sunset over the Arabian Sea with a refreshing coconut water.

activities.title: Dinner at local restaurant
activities.description: Try authentic bebinca and Goan prawn balchao for dinner.

activities.title: Morning coffee and pastry
activities.description: Start the day slowly with local coffee and a bakery snack.

activities.title: Calangute Beach Walk
activities.description: Enjoy a peaceful morning walk along the coastline collecting shells.

activities.title: Local spice-infused lunch
activities.description: Relish a traditional Goan thali featuring local vegetarian and non-vegetarian delicacies.

activities.title: Souvenir shopping
activities.description: Browse local markets for spices, cashews, and handmade crafts.

activities.title: Farewell dinner
activities.description: Dine at a cozy coastal eatery enjoying the relaxed evening atmosphere.

summary: A relaxing 2-day beach and local food getaway in Goa.
